mapper.select: INSERT INTO queue_message (topic, message_key, message_value, status, succeeded_at) VALUES (#{topic}, #{key}, #{value}, 'PENDING', NULL) RETURNING
SELECT FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND message_key = #{key} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND message_key = #{key} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT message_key AS key, MIN(id) AS oldest_message_id FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING' GROUP BY message_key HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{batchSize} ORDER BY MIN(id)
mapper.update: UPDATE queue_message SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', succeeded_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND id IN #{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING'
